extra: Custom 1 MiB / two 468 KiB application-slot layout for the tested Tenda Beli SP9 V1.0 (RTL8710BX).

Relay PA12/GPIO12 active high is verified on the tested SP9. PA18/GPIO18 provides a load-correlated pulse signal used for a provisional power estimate calibrated at 4.1 W only. Meter IC, cross-load accuracy, LED and button pins remain unverified. Do not enable an all-pins output sweep.
